affordances.name: EffectComposer
affordances.semantic: Post-processing composer with multiple shader passes

affordances.name: AberrationSlider
affordances.semantic: Range slider controlling chromatic aberration strength

checks.expr: (() => { const hs=["aberration slider", "input[type=range]"]; const all=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *')); const text=(tag,value)=>all.some(el=>(!tag||el.tagName.toLowerCase()===tag)&&String(el.textContent||'').trim().toLowerCase().includes(value.toLowerCase())); return hs.some(raw=>{ const h=String(raw).trim(); if(!h)return false; try { if(document.querySelector(h))return true; } catch {} const id=h.replace(/^#/,''); if(/^[A-Za-z][\w:.-]*$/.test(id)&&document.getElementById(id))return true; const quoted=h.match(/^(?:([a-z]+)\s+)?(?:with\s+)?text\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]$/i)||h.match(/^([a-z]+)\s+labeled\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]$/i); if(quoted&&text((quoted[1]||'').toLowerCase(),quoted[2]))return true; const label=h.match(/^(.*?)(?:\s+button|\s+slider|\s+panel)$/i); return label ? text('',label[1]) : text('',h); }); })()

affordances.name: RotatingObjects
affordances.semantic: Five geometric objects rotating in the scene

action.code: const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]'); for (const s of sliders) { if (s.min === '0' && parseFloat(s.max) <= 0.05) { s.value = 0.02; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); break; } }
const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); canvas.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', {deltaY: -300, bubbles: true}));
